task: Calibrate a more likeable, honest, and ownable Starlight eye language without redesigning the full cast.
surface: Internal Starlight character studio and future .ai/.org identity systems after approval.
audience: Creators, developers, founders, researchers, and operators.

references.label: Lyra V1.5 identity candidate
references.reason: Provide a controlled face, material, lighting, and identity starting point.

references.label: Existing eye systems
references.reason: Preserve prior evidence about small dots, wide light wells, square apertures, narrow eyes, visors, single irises, and asymmetry.

references.label: Human–robot interaction evidence
references.reason: Record primary-source findings and the design inferences derived from them.

avoid: wet human eyes and biological mimicry
projected emotions and deceptive facial simulation
direction.signature: A softly faceted, medium-small, low-luminance optical iris with a movable dark focus core and quiet mechanical petals.
system: generate one eye-language candidate per call
inspect the repo copy at high detail
record prompt, original path, repo path, hash, dimensions, score, and decision
treat gaze states as functional communication rather than simulated emotion
require human selection before an identity-preserving master edit

asset_quality.why_premium: Four controlled variants isolate human readability, poetic non-human construction, explicit machine vision, and the anthropomorphic boundary; every prompt and export receipt is preserved and the complete set was inspected.

checks.name: machine-admission
checks.evidence: Peak Performance interactive preflight returned ALLOW with one parallel job.

checks.name: one-call-per-asset
checks.evidence: Four sequential built-in image generation calls produced four separately prompted assets.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: All four repo copies were inspected at high detail.

checks.name: prompt-and-provenance
checks.evidence: Exact prompt text, generated source, repo copy, SHA-256, dimensions, score, and decision are recorded for every option.

checks.name: identity-preservation
checks.evidence: All four close-up studies drifted some face geometry and are therefore eye-language concepts, not identity masters.

checks.name: human-taste-selection
checks.evidence: Frank has not yet selected E01, E02, E03, or the recommended E01 × E02 synthesis.

score.notes: E01 is the strongest single candidate at 25/30; the proposed hybrid requires human selection and a precise identity-restoration pass.
